rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a group or people are not united.

example.english: Everyone in our group is really split.
example.traditional: 我哋成班人都好唔團結。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 seng4 baan1 jan4 dou1 hou2 m4 tyun4 git3

rows.note: Use this specifically when people are split because their opinions or positions differ on an issue.

example.english: Everyone’s opinions are split on this issue, so we haven’t settled it yet.
example.traditional: 呢個議題大家意見唔一致，仲未傾掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 daai6 gaa1 ji3 gin3 m4 jat1 zi3 zung6 mei6 king1 dim6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for dividing or sharing something among people.

example.english: We split this sum of money into three shares.
example.traditional: 我哋將呢筆錢分咗三份。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 ni1 bat1 cin2 fan1 zo2 saam1 fan6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a crack or narrow fissure in a surface.

example.english: There’s a split in the wall.
example.jyutping: coeng4 san1 jau5 tiu4 lit6 fung6

rows.note: Use this for a division or breakup within a political party or group.

example.english: The split within the party has left everyone unsure what to do.
example.traditional: 個黨內部分裂，搞到大家都唔知點算。
example.jyutping: go3 dong2 noi6 bou6 fan1 lit6 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3

rows.note: Use this when something physically splits or cracks open, including wood splitting along its grain.

example.english: The wooden board split along the grain.
example.traditional: 塊木板沿住木紋裂開咗。
example.jyutping: faai3 muk6 baan2 jyun4 zyu6 muk6 man4 lit6 hoi1 zo2

rows.note: Use this for a fragment or small piece broken off from something.

example.english: The glass fell on the floor, leaving split-off fragments everywhere.
example.traditional: 塊玻璃跌落地，周圍都係碎片。
example.jyutping: faai3 bo1 lei1 dit3 lok6 dei6 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 seoi3 pin3

rows.note: Use this specifically when romantic partners split up.

example.english: They dated for three years, but eventually they split.
example.traditional: 佢哋拍咗三年拖，最後都係分手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 saam1 nin4 to1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 fan1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for an actual tear or opening in fabric or another stretched material, rather than a surface crack.

example.english: The trousers tore and split open at the side.
example.traditional: 條褲拉爆咗，側邊開咗個裂口。
example.jyutping: tiu4 fu3 laai1 baau3 zo2 zak1 bin1 hoi1 zo2 go3 lit6 hau2

rows.note: Use this colloquially when “split” means to leave or go away.

example.jyutping: gam3 je6 laa3 ngo5 dei6 zau2 laa3
